messages:
oliver: quick postmortem follow-up for INC-2026-043 \u2014 canary r50->r100 caused 10% error spike after 7m. want tracked action items: auto-rollback knobs, blast-radius caps, improved detection for multipart/batched payloads.
tash: timeline pls? and where did detection fail vs ops decision?
oliver: timeline: rollout start 01:08, first 5xx at 01:12, error-rate hit 8% by 01:14, ops saw dashboards at 01:17, manual rollback at 01:19. detection pipeline did not fire because p95 latency rose but error-rate window was 5m threshold.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout "canary/edge-serve-v3" started by priya at 1725005400. Auto-rollback: OFF. Manual rollback recorded at 1725006740.
priya: recurring note: multipart upload paths saw increased timeouts in two other incidents (Q1, Q2). suspect batching + cache TTL interplay. we need regression tests inside canary suite for multipart sizes > 5MB.
zhou: proposal: policy fields: detection_window_s, max_error_pct, max_blast_pct, ramp_steps (for soft drain), and a sampling flag to run heavy payloads through canary nodes only. defaults: detection_window_s=120, max_error_pct=4, max_blast_pct=8, ramp_steps=3.
priya: I can own the auto-rollback state machine and the policy surface. will add telemetry events: canary.policy.triggered, canary.rollout.drain_step, canary.rollback.reason. ETA: 2w for core + unit tests.
tash: I'll add enforcement in the router for max_blast_pct and a tenant-level override key only SRE/admin can flip. PR target: 1w.
oliver: good. also add an ops runbook snippet: if canary_policy triggers AND service-level error spike -> page SRE, set traffic cap to 0 for affected route, then hit rollback. i'll draft and put in postmortem doc.
zhou: alerting change: composite alert = (canary.error_rate > max_error_pct) AND (canary.latency_p95 > 1.5s) for 90s => page oncall. also surface the last_healthy_ts and current_traffic_pct in the alert payload.
priya: config example for reviewers:
```yaml
canary_policy:
  enabled: true
  detection_window_s: 120
  max_error_pct: 4
  max_blast_pct: 8
  ramp_steps: 3   # number of reductions before full rollback
  auto_rollback: true
  sampling_heavy_payloads: true
```
oliver: owners & quick plan: priya -> auto-rollback engine + telemetry (2w), tash -> router blast-radius enforcement + admin-override (1w), zhou -> canary synthetics for multipart/batched workloads + alerts (10d), oliver -> runbook + postmortem doc updates (3d).
priya: will include incident id in every PR description (INC-2026-043) and open tracking ticket RINF-679 tying PRs.
tash: i'll coordinate with product on default gating: auto_rollback ON for internal/hotfix branches, OFF for external major releases unless opt-in.
zhou: i'll add canary-only synthetic that posts 10 multipart requests/min with varying sizes, results logged to canary-eval pipeline. ETA 9d.
oliver: deploy-bot, schedule weekly follow-ups until all items closed.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: weekly-checkin (canary-hardening) starting 1725014100.
priya: ok, opening initial PRs this week for DSL and unit tests.
tash: i'll land router checks and a small admin UI toggle.
oliver: thanks everyone. i'll add owners to the postmortem and set calendar invites for the weekly sync. ping me if you need reassignment. :thumbsup:
